title: Counit computation of the open composition comparison on a K-injective complex
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq Y$ an arbitrary open, and suppose the derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] on X, Y and every open of each exist in one morphism universe. Put $V=h^{-1}(U)$, $j_X:V\to X$, $j_Y:U\to Y$, and $g:V\to U$. Let $L_X,L_Y$ be exact derived restrictions [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], with their fixed derived adjunctions $a_X,a_Y$ [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. Write $F=Rh_*$, $G=Rg_*$, $R_X=Rj_{X*}$, $R_Y=Rj_{Y*}$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Let $\alpha:F L_Y\cong L_X G$ be the fixed derived open-restriction comparison, and $\beta:R_X F\cong G R_Y$ the supplied isomorphism fixed by equality to the two normalized composition comparisons joined by $j_X h=g j_Y$, both from [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data], with juxtaposition in Lean functor order. For every K-injective cochain complex I of structure-sheaf modules on V [def-pur-kinjective-complex], with A=Q(I), one has $L_Y(\beta_A)\,\varepsilon_{Y,G(A)}=\alpha_{R_X(A)}\,G(\varepsilon_{X,A})$, in Lean composition order. No cover and no restriction unit on an object of X is present.

proof.text: Use the composition-unit normalization on the homotopy quotient K of I. Use the restriction-unit normalization on jX_*K. These are two separate factorization equations without counits.

Apply Mathlib Adjunction.derivedε_fac_app for the two specialized open adjunctions. Naturality of the derived counit and exact-localization comparison computes the left path after precomposition by the pasted units as lambdaY followed by Q of the underived left path followed by the g unit. Naturality of the restriction comparison and g unit computes the right path as lambdaY followed by Q of the underived right path followed by the g unit. The underived counit square identifies the two paths.

The open direct image preserves K-injective complexes by the proved Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes API, because restriction is exact. Hence both source units used for precomposition are isomorphisms at K; cancel their image under restriction. Transport the resulting square along quotientCompQhIso at I using naturality of the two counit composites. This gives the unchanged theorem at Q(I).
